high_level_description: The image is a map of the eastern United States, specifically highlighting areas affected by a heat wave. The map uses a color-coded system to indicate different levels of heat risk: Light yellow represents "Minor" heat risk. Medium yellow indicates "Moderate" heat risk. Orange signifies "Major" heat risk. Red denotes "Extreme" heat risk. The map shows a significant area of red and orange, particularly concentrated in the Midwest and parts of the East Coast, indicating extreme and major heat risks across these regions. The states highlighted include Illinois (IL), Indiana (IN), Ohio
